name: How long does mobile home wall and ceiling repair usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does mobile home wall and ceiling repair usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a basic patch, repairs can often be completed in a single visit once materials are on hand. Larger jobs, leak-related damage, or texture matching may take longer because drying time, cleanup, and finish work all add steps.
acceptedAnswer.description: Simple patches may take one visit, while bigger water-damage or texture-match repairs can take longer because of drying and finish work.
